title: Migrate game exports and golden exports to JSON5
description:
Convert game exports (website/public/games/) and golden export tests (puppeteer/tests/golden/exports/) from JSON to JSON5.

Requires changes on both Python and TypeScript sides:
- Python: update scripts/game_exports.py and schemas/game_export_types.py
- TypeScript: add json5 npm dependency, update load-games.ts and load-full-game.ts
- Handle .json.gz to .json5.gz extension transition
- Bulk convert ~375 game export files
- Rename and regenerate 15 golden export files
